thesis.problem: European road freight is a market of very large shippers and very small hauliers: a manufacturer with thousands of loads a week on one side, and on the other tens of thousands of carriers running a handful of trucks each. Matching them has historically been done by phone and fax through forwarders, and roughly a fifth of trucks run empty because nobody can see the whole board at once.
thesis.solution: sennder is a digital forwarder: it contracts directly with the large shippers and dispatches the work across a connected fleet of third-party carriers through its own platform, so pricing, tracking and settlement are software rather than phone calls. It has grown as much by absorbing rivals — Everoad, Uber Freight’s European arm, C.H. Robinson’s European surface transport business — as organically.

disputed.note: A €2bn figure is attached to sennder in Tech.eu’s December 2022 headline, “German logistics player Sennder primes new fundraise at €2 billion valuation”. The article body is about a raise that was being prepared, not one that closed: it reports sennder “taking on funds” at around double its January 2021 value, on Handelsblatt’s account, citing unnamed sources and €60m clinched so far. No completed round at that price has been reported since, so the register keeps the last valuation actually struck.

sources.title: Berlin-based digital freight forwarder Sennder bags $160 million at a $1 billion+ valuation
sources.quote: Berlin-based digital freight forwarder sennder has secured $160 million at a $1 billion+ valuation in growth funding to "accelerate digitalization of European trucking" and boost its expansion plans.

sources.title: Digital road freight forwarder Sennder raises $160M Series, plans European expansion
sources.quote: Sennder, a large digital road freight forwarder based out of Germany, has raised $160 million in Series D financing. The round was led by an unnamed party, but round participants included Accel, Lakestar, HV Capital, Project A and Scania.

sources.title: German logistics player Sennder primes new fundraise at €2 billion valuation
sources.quote: Sennder's existing investors include Accel, Lakestare, HV Capital, Project A and Scania. Its most recent funding haul was the second series D close in June 2021 which added $80 million to the $160 million in fund raised that January.

sources.title: German logistics player Sennder primes new fundraise at €2 billion valuation
sources.quote: Berlin-based logistics services startup Sennder is taking on funds at around double the $1 billion or so value it received for equity issued January 2021, when it took $160 million to ramp up its digitised freight trucking strategy.

sources.title: Freight forwarder sennder raises $80M at a $1B+ valuation
sources.quote: Sennder, a digital freight forwarder that focuses on moving cargo around Europe (and specifically focusing on trucks and “full truck load”, FTL, freight forwarding), has raised $80 million in funding, at a valuation the company confirms is now over $1 billion.

sources.title: Freight forwarder sennder raises $80M at a $1B+ valuation
sources.quote: The Berlin-based startup has been on something of a funding tear this year. In January, it announced a $160 million round, and this $80 million is closing out its Series D. Baillie Gifford led this latest Series D extension, with Hedosophia, Accel, Lakestar, HV Capital, Project A and Scania all participating in the previous part of the Series D.

sources.title: Freight forwarder sennder raises $80M at a $1B+ valuation
sources.quote: The funding makes sennder, which has now raised some $350 million, one of the most well-funded of the freight forwarders, but it’s a hot area at the moment.
